summary: Iteration 234 - Batch 22 (Ops v2: Maintenance Work-Order State Machine + Linen PAR + HK Inspection) tested. Backend: 26/26 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified and interactive features working.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/ops-v2/workorders/{property_id} returns rows[], counters{}, critical_open count
POST /api/ops-v2/workorders creates work order with status='reported' and events[] array
GET /api/ops-v2/linen/{property_id} returns items[] with states{clean,dirty,washing,in_use,lost}, low_par_count, low_par[]
POST /api/ops-v2/linen/cycle supports 5 movements: clean_to_in_use, checkout_to_dirty, dirty_to_washing, washing_to_clean, lost_or_damaged
POST /api/ops-v2/linen/{property_id}/seed-defaults creates 5 default linen items with initial stock
POST /api/ops-v2/inspection auto-creates work orders for failed checks with priority='high' and category='housekeeping'
GET /api/ops-v2/inspections/{property_id} returns rows[], total, failed, pass_rate percentage
Frontend uses Turkish labels: Bakım İş Emirleri, Çamaşır PAR, HK Denetim
seed_data_creation: Test work orders and inspections created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 234 validates Batch 22 (Ops v2). Sidebar: '🔧 Ops v2 (Bakım + Linen + Denetim)' (data-testid='ops-v2-btn'). Panel: data-testid='ops-v2-panel'. 3 tabs: 'Bakım İş Emirleri' (ops-tab-maintenance), 'Çamaşır PAR' (ops-tab-linen), 'HK Denetim' (ops-tab-inspection). Maintenance tab: KPI tiles (ops-kpi-critical/open/completed/verified), status filters (ops-filter-all/reported/assigned/in_progress/completed/verified), work order list (ops-wo-list), new WO button (ops-new-wo-btn), action buttons (ops-wo-action-{id}). Linen tab: low PAR badge (linen-low-par-badge), item cards (linen-card-{type}), cycle button (linen-cycle-{type}), movement buttons (linen-move-{type}-{movement}). Inspection tab: KPI tiles (insp-kpi-total/pass/failed), new button (insp-new-btn), form (insp-form), room input (insp-room-id), check toggles (insp-check-{i}), notes (insp-notes-{i}), submit (insp-submit), history (insp-history).
